# BrewPage publishing plugins

Publish HTML pages, Markdown, files and static sites from AI agents and
automation tools to BrewPage

and get an HTTPS link back.
No signup or API key. Publications are temporary: 15 days by default, 3

0 at most
(90 with a free profile).
## Integrations

AI-agent packages are assets of the latest release,
v1.0.4;
check them against SHASUMS256.txt.
